name: momentum-flick-card
title: Momentum Flick Card
description: A card deck element that responds to pointer swipe velocity, flying away when flicked beyond velocity threshold or springing back to center.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Swipe Throw Gesture: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
